rows.grounds: indeclinable temporal adverb indicating sequence after the action described in the previous verse
genitive dependent qualifying arghyaṃ as the oblation belonging to or associated with fire
ritual offering; direct object of samādāya
absolutive expressing prior action completed before the next implied step
bahuvrīhi or descriptive compound qualifying arghyaṃ/vyavasthitām; internal sandhi marked by +
past participle qualifying the oblation as set or arranged in that form

items.question: What action must the practitioner perform with the fire-formed oblation after preparing the maṇḍala?
premises: The practitioner has prepared a square maṇḍala on the ground.
After that preparation, the oblation of fire is to be taken.
The oblation is established in the form of fire.
items.inference: Following the preparation of the maṇḍala, the practitioner should take up the oblation of fire, established in fire-form.
uncertainties: The exact ritual handling after taking the oblation is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Then, having taken the oblation of fire, established in the form of fire.
